title: Intraoperative STN/thalamic DBS-lead LFP with subgaleal sensorimotor strips during a stop-signal task (Diesburg, Greenlee & Wessel, 2021)
description: Intraoperative local field potentials recorded from deep brain stimulation leads in the subthalamic nucleus or ventral intermediate thalamus, together with subgaleal strips over sensorimotor cortex. Patients undergoing DBS surgery performed an auditory stop-signal task and a go-only localizer. The dataset supports investigation of cortico-subcortical beta burst dynamics underlying movement cancellation, with 47 recordings from 23 subjects.
methods_description: Recordings were made at University of Iowa Hospitals and Clinics (April 2018 to March 2020) using a TDT system with an RA16PA Medusa preamplifier and RA16LI headstage (hardware low-pass 7.5 kHz). Medtronic 3387 DBS leads and 4-, 6- or 8-contact subgaleal strips were used. Sampling rates were 2000 or 24000 Hz. Task triggers were captured as TTL pulses on analog input channels.
